scope: Actual integrated stop-health simplification, controller equivalence tests, isolated synthesis, and final timing evidence from the preceding complete receiver. No deployment qualification.

implementation.premise: The actual acquisition-health producer updates five saturating counters and their sticky cause bits on the same clock edge and reset epoch.
implementation.change: Reuse the existing masked sticky flags instead of reducing those five redundant 32-bit counters on stop admission. Retain all counters in the snapshot ABI.

controller_equivalence.real_producer_tests: Each of five counter causes before stop admission, after acceptance, and around terminal retirement; actual AXI controller and real map core; read/release and retained fault receipts.
controller_equivalence.generic_fallback: Each independent counter's high bit with no corresponding flag still rejects admission in default mode.
controller_equivalence.limits: Tested RTL workloads, not formal equivalence or synthesized functional simulation. The inherited bench also uses explicit decoder forcing and boundary counter seeds for selected races. No ADC, DMA, native IIO or RF proof.

isolated_synthesis.scope: Same actual PSMA controller and AXI helper, two explicit parameter modes. Synthetic 10 ns clock and 0 ns I/O delays only for this isolated probe; no receiver constraint changes.
isolated_synthesis.retained_failed_v1: Unsupported remove_from_collection Tcl command, after synthesis. Corrected to Vivado get_ports filtering and reran into a new v2 directory; failed evidence was not overwritten.

preceding_full_receiver_final.stop_health_path_still_relevant: scheduler_overflow_count_reg[17] to phase-map bank RAM enable has -3.351 ns slack in the final baseline.
preceding_full_receiver_final.limits: These are final measurements of preceding runtime 653a3205, not of the new stop-health implementation. Broad routing congestion and separate fast-domain paths remain; the isolated 8-LUT reduction is not a timing-closure claim.

new_full_receiver_build.launch_conditions: Clean HDL at the pinned commit, fresh project directory, no reference.dcp, ADI_USE_OOC_SYNTHESIS=n; same 15 MS/s paired-pilot/shared-realtime/boundary-stop profile and constraints as the baseline.
